CustomField.label: Loan history facts
CustomField.description: SCRUM-468 round 4 (Architect AC7 shape): guard-written Text column for the device history related list. LoanRecordGuard writes "open / due dd.mm.yyyy" at lend, LoanReturnGuard rewrites "returned dd.mm.yyyy / n Tage" at return. Not a formula: a formula column does not render in this list and the field type cannot be changed in place.
